title: Selection
description: Deterministic selector output. Functionality gate first: candidates below 0.9 are disqualified. Among qualifiers, final = 0.40 functionality + 0.35 ux_clarity + 0.25 design_coherence, tie-break on ux_clarity. On success, winner is a scored candidate and losers and rationale are present. When no candidate clears the gate, winner is null and reason explains it. Documented in shared/schemas/README.md. No em dashes in any string value.

winner.description: The selected candidate, or null when all candidates failed the functionality gate.

losers.description: Every candidate that is not the winner. Routed to the curator. Present on success.

rationale.description: Short human-readable reason, for example Selected B at 0.92. Present on success.

reason.description: Set only when winner is null, for example All candidates failed the functionality gate. Try a simpler version of the request.

scored_candidate.description: A Candidate merged with its headline judge scores and the computed final_score. final_score is present for candidates that cleared the gate; losers that failed the gate may omit it. Extra fields (full judge detail) may ride along.

examples.reason: All candidates failed the functionality gate. Try a simpler version of the request.
